allow_instructions: Auto-approve local terminal commands for this repo: pnpm, npm, npx, node, python3, prisma, playwright, curl, git (non-destructive), vercel, gh, and next/dev servers.
Allow Marketplace Forge work: /api/forge calls, skill package build/publish via repository APIs, sandbox prove, lint, typecheck, test, and build.
Allow Eve builder work: /builder/eve, /api/eve/*, architect/run status polls, project workspace file reads, and local eve package docs under node_modules/eve/docs.
Allow Vercel MCP read/list/logs and Neon read-only SQL (SELECT, describe schema, list tables). Allow Firebench UI edits and skill-workspace CSS/TSX changes.
Allow installing or updating local deps with pnpm when needed for Forge/Eve development.
block_instructions: Block git push --force, git reset --hard, sudo, and rm -rf targeting / or ~.
Block committing or printing secrets, .env*, API keys, tokens, or credentials into chat, packages, Neon messages, or permissions files.
Block weakening product HITL: public-publish gates, destructive-shell confirms, and terminal confirmDestructive checks must stay intact.
Ask before production deploys (vercel --prod), database migrations that DROP/TRUNCATE/DELETE without WHERE, or changing Clerk/auth fail-closed middleware.
Ask before writing outside this workspace except ~/.cursor/permissions.json or project .cursor config the user requested.
